name: Peja & Rugova Canyon in a day
description_md:
The Peja and Rugova Canyon route is a one day city sightseeing walk in XK. This path covers 9.6 km of walking between stops.

The route includes 5 sightseeing stops. The full day lasts about 6.7 hours including visit time at each stop. The day is anchored in Peja and Rugova Canyon.
